newsitem.title: USA: Nursing aide guilty of raping coma victim.
newsitem.headline: Nursing aide guilty of raping coma victim.

text.p: A former nursing assistant was convicted on Thursday of raping a comatose nursing-home patient who later gave birth to a healthy baby boy.
The defendent, John Horace, was convicted of rape and sexual assault. He faced up to 25 years in prison when he is sentenced March 27.

The jury decided Horace raped his unnamed victim, who has been in a coma since a car accident 11 years ago, in August 1995 while working as a nursing assistant at the Westfall Health Care Facility in Brighton, New York. She later gave birth to a baby boy, who is being raised by her mother.

Prosecuting attorneys based their case on DNA evidence that showed a more-than-99 percent probability that Horace was the father of the child. Authorities collected blood and saliva samples from an envelope licked by Horace and compared them with the baby's blood and amniotic fluid from the mother's womb.
When the verdict was read, Horace, 53, remained stony-faced, while the victim's family hugged.
Outside the courthouse, two of the baby's aunts said their pain was alleviated by their love for the baby, who turns one in March. It was the first time the victim's family had made a statement.
"He's just adorable," said one of the woman, who refused to give her name. "We love him to death."

John Parrinello, the prosecuting attorney, said that the family planned to file a civil case against the nursing home, which has changed owners in the past year. It is now called the Meadows at Westfall.

Horace, 53, worked at the Westfall facility for six weeks. He has already served time for two other sex crimes. Last year, he pleaded guilty to impersonating a physician at a "sex therapy clinic" and was convicted of fondling another Westfall patient, a 49-year-old multiple sclerosis patient.
